source: APPP / MAFF-JICA — Rice Seed Production Manual (សៀវភៅមគ្គទេសក៍ផលិតកម្មពូជស្រូវ), 2014, Agricultural Productivity Promotion Project in West Tonle Sap, p.33
text: Field inspection standards for CERTIFIED seed class (ពូជអនុញ្ញាត), by inspection level — generally a looser tier than registered seed: Level 1 (nursery/establishment stage): field isolated from other varieties by at least 5 m if the neighboring variety flowers at the same time; crop growth uniformity at least 70%; pest/disease damage within tolerable level (up to about 10%); no mixed varieties present. Level 2 (about 30 days after transplanting): growth uniformity at least 70%; bacterial leaf blight in the field itself must be 0%; bacterial leaf blight in a neighboring farmer's field within 5 m must not exceed 5 infected plants per 100 m²; pest/disease damage within tolerable level (up to about 10%); off-type/mixed-variety plants no more than 3 per 100 m²; plus a weed-infestation check. Level 3 (flowering/heading stage): field isolated by at least 5 m if the flowering-date gap from a neighboring different variety is only about 5 days (a shorter, less strict gap than registered seed's 7-day requirement); at least 70% of hills flowering; pest/disease damage within tolerable level (up to about 10%); off-type/mixed-variety plants no more than 3 per 100 m². Level 4 (near-maturity stage): pest/disease damage within tolerable level (up to about 10%); off-type/mixed-variety plants no more than 3 per 100 m². Level 5 (harvested seed-lot / production-output inspection): the final product standard shown is the same as for registered seed — pure seed at least 98%, broken/damaged grain no more than 2%, weed seed no more than 0.1% (a looser threshold than registered seed's 0.05%), mixture with other varieties no more than 0.2% (looser than registered seed's 0.1%), moisture content no more than 13%, full/sound grain ratio at least 95%.
